name: MuseInu
description: MUSEINU — Muse, all fuzzy blue. The funding sets up the agents: a launchpad where agents and humans launch side by side, fused for fairness. End the bundles. End the PvP. End the sniping. No pre-allocation, no bundle. The creator buys on the curve in the open, from the public wallet, like everyone else — and we see what happens.
